items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Lionel said I want him to do about four or five things... that ended my writing for Hampton.

ctx.x: They generally didn't have control of the money, presumably then.
That's where all the power was. That was that experience. I can always say I almost wrote for Lionel Hampton. It was a name like Willard Alexander. It wasn't Willard.
It will pop up. Was that your experience with managers all through your career, presumably?
